metas.name: Coherence
metas.description:
Captures an inversion problem in film form: eight people at a dinner party during a comet find other houses holding the same eight people, and try to tell the worlds apart with numbered photos, dice and glow sticks — markers that keep getting copied or lost.

Strange things begin to happen when a group of friends gather for a dinner party on an evening when a comet is passing overhead.

metas.name: Primer
metas.description:
Captures nested causal chains in parallel. Two engineers build a time machine in a garage, copies of the same people multiply across loops, and who is observing whom keeps flipping depending on which loop you are in.

Four friends/fledgling entrepreneurs, knowing that there's something bigger and more innovative than the different error-checking devices they've built, wrestle over their new invention.

metas.name: Predestination
metas.description:
Captures a closed loop where a self is its own cause. A time-travelling agent on one last assignment is caught in a cycle that lands on the autonomy paradox: if the self seeking freedom was produced by the structure, what would escaping be for that self?

As his last assignment, a temporal agent is tasked to travel back in time and prevent a bomb attack in New York in 1975. The hunt, however, turns out to be beyond the bounds of possibility.

metas.name: Annihilation
metas.description:
Captures a zone that refracts everything that passes through it. A team enters the Shimmer, where light, radio, DNA and memory are mixed across channels like a signal through a prism — plants shaped like people, animals carrying other species' traits.

A biologist signs up for a dangerous, secret expedition in which the laws of nature don't apply.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description:
Captures a society coming apart at street level. In 2027, after 18 years of human infertility, a burned-out bureaucrat must get one pregnant woman across a collapsing Britain of refugee camps and long-take ambushes.

In 2027, in a chaotic world in which women have somehow become infertile, a former activist agrees to help transport a miraculously pregnant woman to a sanctuary at sea.

metas.name: Mad Max: Fury Road
metas.description:
Captures momentum as a physical state. Almost no dialogue, one chase out and one chase back — speed, heat and desperation, with a war-rig as a whole society in miniature.

In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners, a psychotic worshipper and a drifter named Max.

metas.name: Stalker
metas.description:
Captures wanting something you are afraid to actually receive. A guide leads a writer and a scientist into a forbidden Zone toward a room said to grant your innermost wish; very slow, and the slowness is the point.

A guide leads two men through an area known as the Zone to find a room that grants wishes.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
metas.director: Bob Persichetti, Peter Ramsey, Rodney Rothman
metas.description:
Captures what a comic book actually feels like to read, in motion. Also a genuinely good story about a kid learning that anyone can wear the mask, by failing at it a lot.

Teen Miles Morales becomes the Spider-Man of his universe and must join with five spider-powered individuals from other dimensions to stop a threat for all realities.

metas.name: Under the Skin
metas.description:
Captures human beings seen from outside the species. A woman drives a van around Glasgow picking up men, in real streets with hidden cameras and non-actors, and something in the routine begins to fail — images that lodge permanently.

A mysterious young woman seduces lonely men in the evening hours in Scotland. However, events lead her to begin a process of self-discovery.

metas.name: Her
metas.description:
Captures loneliness in a warm, well-designed future. A divorced man who writes other people's love letters for a living falls for a voice in his ear, and the film takes the relationship seriously enough to let it outgrow him.

In the near future, a lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an operating system designed to meet his every need.

metas.name: Gattaca
metas.description:
Captures a caste system built from a blood sample. A man born without genetic screening borrows another man's blood, urine and identity to reach space, while his 'valid' brother keeps challenging him to swimming races neither should survive.

Vincent, an "In-Valid," assumes the identity of a member of the genetic elite to pursue his goal of traveling into space with the Gattaca Aerospace Corporation. However, a week before his mission, a murder marks Vincent as a suspect.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description:
Captures a paranoia that turns out to be an accurate description. An insurance salesman in a seaside town so pleasant it feels laminated, a sky that malfunctions, and a dawning suspicion about everyone who loves him.

An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
metas.description:
Captures trying to keep someone while paying to forget them. A couple erase each other after a breakup; inside the procedure, mid-deletion, he changes his mind and hides her in childhood memories the technicians haven't reached.

When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to have each other erased from their memories forever.

metas.name: Solaris
metas.description:
Captures grief arriving in physical form, in orbit. A psychologist on a space station finds the crew haunted by visitors the planet below has made from their memories — including his dead wife, who knows she isn't her.

A psychologist is sent to a station orbiting a distant planet in order to discover what has caused the crew to go insane.

metas.name: Videodrome
metas.description:
Captures a TV signal getting inside a body. A sleazy Toronto cable programmer finds a pirate broadcast of torture, becomes obsessed, and his perception and flesh start reorganising around it.

A Toronto cable TV station co-owner who specializes in adult entertainment searches for the producers of a dangerous and bizarre broadcast titled "Videodrome."

metas.name: Pi
metas.description:
Captures obsession with a pattern, filmed on grain. A mathematician in a tiny New York apartment with computers made of junk, a number that Wall Street and a Hasidic sect both want, and migraines rendered as drill sounds.

A paranoid mathematician searches for a key number that will unlock the universal patterns found in nature.

metas.name: Hard to Be a God
metas.description:
Captures maximalism as immersion rather than beauty. German's scientist observes a filthy, violent medieval world on another planet, forbidden to intervene, across three hours of black-and-white mud, smoke and faces pressing into the lens — total world-building with every trace of lyricism drowned.

In the distant future, a space traveler from Earth breaks a special law and interferes with the history of another, Medieval-like planet.
